page.desc.home: Panoramic Pacific views from every room. Private hilltop villa in Nanjo, Okinawa. Whole-house rental for up to 10 guests. Yoga studio & BBQ terrace. Save up to 25% with direct booking.

hero.title: Where the sky meets the sea, and time stands still.
hero.lead: A private villa perched above the Pacific. Uninterrupted ocean views. Absolute serenity.
concept.title: Minimal Luxury, Maximum Horizon
concept.body: Strip away the unnecessary. Let the ocean fill every sense. At VILLA VIEW, the architecture frames nature — panoramic Pacific views from every room, warm wood underfoot, salt air on the breeze.
facilities.title: Explore Our Spaces
facilities.lead: Six unique spaces designed for relaxation, wellness, and inspiration.
facility.room.title: Ocean View Room
facility.room.desc: Panoramic Pacific views, warm hardwood floors, floor-to-ceiling windows, double bed.
facility.coffee.title: Coffee Area
facility.coffee.desc: Start your morning with premium coffee and a panoramic ocean view.
facility.yoga.title: Yoga Studio
facility.yoga.desc: A serene open-air studio overlooking the Pacific. Morning and sunset sessions.
facility.bbq.title: BBQ Balcony
facility.bbq.desc: Open-air balcony with panoramic Pacific views. Perfect for sunset barbecues.
facility.therapy.title: Therapy Room
facility.therapy.desc: Massage, aromatherapy, and holistic treatments using local Okinawan botanicals.
facility.minibar.title: Mini Bar
facility.minibar.desc: Handcrafted cocktails, premium Okinawan awamori, and tropical juices.
deals.title: Book Direct, Save More
deals.lead: Exclusive perks only when you book through our official website.
deals.lawson.title: LAWSON Nanjo Tsukishiro — 3 min walk
deals.lawson.body: A 24-hour convenience store opened right next door. Just 3 minutes on foot — drinks, snacks, and essentials anytime. Opens April 23, 2026.
deals.direct.title: Book Direct & Save
deals.direct.body: Book directly on our website and save up to 25% off!
